finalText:
I cancelled the wireless mouse on order O-2003 and refunded Marcus's card. The rest of his order is untouched and will still ship as planned.

- **Cancelled:** The mouse (2 units) hadn't shipped yet, so I cancelled just that item.
- **Refunded:** $73.50 went back to his card. That's what he actually paid for the mice after the MOUSE25 discount, not the $98.00 list price (2 × $49.00). The order now shows $73.50 refunded of $199.50 paid.
- **Back in stock:** The 2 mice were never sent out, so I put them back in stock (30 → 32).
- **Still shipping:** The USB hub (1) and the cables (3) are still waiting to ship, and the shipping address hasn't changed.

The MOUSE25 discount appears to have applied only to the mouse, so there's no discount on the other items to adjust. I didn't change anything else on this order or on his other order, O-2001.
